title: Zendesk resolution history excluded closed-only tickets
evidence: The merged calendar-resolution model changed the status-history filter to admit both solved and closed events, then uses a closed timestamp when a ticket has no solved timestamp. Closed-only histories previously supplied no row to the resolution-time aggregate.
adaptation: Replaces the dbt relation reference with a fixture table and replays only the input filter. The count measures qualifying history rows. The later resolution fallback and final ticket report are outside this replay.
setup_sql:
CREATE TABLE ticket_history (ticket_id INTEGER, status VARCHAR);
INSERT INTO ticket_history VALUES (1, 'open'), (1, 'closed'), (2, 'solved'), (3, 'open');
before_sql: SELECT h.ticket_id AS id, h.status FROM ticket_history AS h WHERE h.status = 'solved'
after_sql: SELECT h.ticket_id AS id, h.status FROM ticket_history AS h WHERE h.status IN ('solved', 'closed')
